name: Efalizumab PASI time-course probes
description: Source-parameter and historical calibrated PASI probes. Four source-table replay jobs are disabled; paper reproduction remains incomplete.

scenarios.name: Gottlieb escalating-dose PASI progression probe
scenarios.description: Reduced first-order progression from Gottlieb baseline PASI toward Chetty source Yss. This is not a Simcyp virtual-population reproduction.

scenarios.name: Gordon 1 mg/kg PASI progression probe
scenarios.description: Reduced first-order progression from Gordon baseline PASI toward Chetty source Yss. This is not a Simcyp virtual-population reproduction.

scenarios.name: Exploratory Calibrated Gottlieb Digitized Pasi Probe
scenarios.description: Exploratory calibrated reduced PASI ODE fit to digitized Chetty Figure 4 points. This is not the paper fixed-effect Simcyp/FcRn model.

scenarios.name: Exploratory Calibrated Gordon Digitized Pasi Probe
scenarios.description: Exploratory calibrated reduced PASI ODE fit to digitized Chetty Figure 4 points. This is not the paper fixed-effect Simcyp/FcRn model.
